name: Penalty 4
definition: Specifies the penalties for a given party.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date where the penalties reported in this block were initially computed.|.

PartyIdentification.name: Party Identification
PartyIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the party within the system.

CounterpartyCSD.name: Counterparty CSD
CounterpartyCSD.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the party for which the aggregated amounts are referred to.

CSDDepository.name: CSD Depository
CSDDepository.definition: Depository/intermediary that is used by an ICSD to access a specific counterparty's CSD, that is the party that services the account.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account account to be debited/credited for the settlement of the penalty.

CashSettlementDate.name: Cash Settlement Date
CashSettlementDate.definition: Date on which the payment of the penalty is due.

NumberOfCounterparties.name: Number Of Counterparties
NumberOfCounterparties.definition: Number of counterparties involved in the penalty.

PenaltyPerCounterparty.name: Penalty Per Counterparty
PenaltyPerCounterparty.definition: Claims (penalties) in a currency and of a date reported for a given party.|If there are no penalties in a given currency for a party, this block will not be informed.

CounterpartyCSDPresenceRule.definition: Either the CounterpartyCSD or PenaltyPerCounterparty/AccountServicer is informed but not both.
